'''Hukowl An Devi''' was a political [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] of the corrupt [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Telos IV]], [[Crion]].

After the end of the [[Telosian Civil War]] and Crion's death, An Devi became the new governor.
